purpose: Select and gate license-safe offline CCTV/traffic-like data for stronger replay testing without claiming production live CCTV.

recommendation.reason: Best license-clear fixed-CCTV traffic source found: Hugging Face lists license cc-by-4.0 and source imagery is captured from operational Safe City CCTV cameras. It is image/annotation based, not video, so R16 should treat it as frame replay, not prerecorded video.
recommendation.secondary_video_candidate: AI City CityFlowV2 or WTS only after license review
recommendation.fallback_not_cctv: BDD100K/CC0 mirror only if license/source provenance is independently verified and labelled as dashcam/traffic-like, not CCTV.

candidates.name: BMD-45
candidates.license_evidence: Hugging Face dataset tree lists License: cc-by-4.0.
candidates.technical_fit: HIGH for CCTV-like fixed-camera vehicle detection and multi-class hardening; MEDIUM for video replay because source is image frames not continuous clips.
candidates.recommended_use: R16 primary source. Build frame-replay subset, sample 50-200 images, generate media provenance and attribution, optionally make synthetic MP4 from ordered frames only if source ordering supports it.

candidates.name: AI City Challenge CityFlowV2
candidates.license_evidence: AI City quick access exists, but historical dataset licenses are limited/revocable challenge licenses; do not assume broad redistribution or commercial/demo rights.
candidates.technical_fit: VERY_HIGH for offline traffic video replay if license gate passes.
candidates.recommended_use: Secondary video source after explicit license approval. Use a tiny subset only, package as external media ref unless redistribution rights are clear.

candidates.name: VIRAT Video Dataset
candidates.license_evidence: VIRAT terms require acceptance/signature by all individuals with dataset access.
candidates.technical_fit: HIGH for surveillance-style scenes, but license/admin overhead makes it unsuitable as the default R16 source.

candidates.name: BDD100K / BDD-derived mirrors
candidates.license_evidence: Official resources describe the dataset; some mirrors claim CC0 but mirrors must not override original dataset terms without review.
candidates.technical_fit: MEDIUM; traffic-like but not fixed CCTV.
candidates.recommended_use: Fallback only; label as dashcam/traffic-like, not CCTV.

candidates.name: Stanford Drone Dataset
candidates.license_evidence: Official page states CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 and non-commercial restrictions.
candidates.technical_fit: MEDIUM for overhead multi-agent replay; not CCTV and not commercial-demo safe without review.

acceptance_rule: R16 may PASS only when at least one dataset source passes license/provenance gate and a bounded replay sample is produced without overclaim.
